sets.relationshipLabel: a place and what it exists to produce
sets.explanation: An apiary exists to produce honey just as a nursery exists to produce seedlings — each place is defined by its output.

sets.relationshipLabel: a worker and the tool of their trade
sets.explanation: A beekeeper always reaches for a smoker and a florist for shears — each worker is defined by the tool that does their job.

sets.relationshipLabel: a flower and a feature it simply has
sets.explanation: A rose has a thorn and an iris has a rhizome — each flower is inseparable from a defining structural feature.

sets.relationshipLabel: two moments facing each other across a span
sets.explanation: Seed and wilt bookend a plant's life just as dusk and dawn bookend the night — each pair marks the two edges of the same cycle.
